question: Does an expression-level top-1/listwise referent loss define a novel core mechanism after PIRS was found to be prior-art score-target supervision?

diagnostic_basis.failure_decomposition: 32 of 38 failures select a non-positive query; 33 of 38 failures contain at least one acceptable query.

proposed_mechanism.summary: Replace independent query-quality targets with a set-level loss over the query population: assign probability mass by softmax over referent logits and minimize the probability mass carried by mask-unacceptable queries, or equivalently optimize the probability that the deployed argmax lies in the acceptable set.
proposed_mechanism.reason_considered: It directly matches the deployed top-1 selection decision and does not regress an auxiliary mask-quality score.

primary_source_audit.title: Rank & Sort Loss for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
primary_source_audit.finding: The original method defines a purely ranking-based classifier loss that ranks each positive above all negatives and sorts positives by continuous localisation quality such as IoU. It explicitly removes the need for an auxiliary IoU/quality head. This covers the core causal mechanism proposed here, namely aligning the classifier ranking/decision directly with predicted-mask quality rather than independently regressing per-query quality.
primary_source_audit.additional_finding: The method is demonstrated on object detection and instance segmentation, so transferring the objective to 3D-RES changes the application surface and candidate construction but not the core decision-aligned ranking mechanism.

primary_source_audit.title: Superpoint Transformer for 3D Scene Instance Segmentation
primary_source_audit.finding: SPFormer already uses predicted-mask quality to supervise query scores, so a local listwise reparameterisation cannot claim novelty from quality-aware referent ranking alone.

verdict.literature_gate: fail for a new core mechanism
verdict.reason: The candidate's whole-mechanism claim would be decision-aligned quality ranking. Rank & Sort Loss already establishes that mechanism, including positive-vs-negative ranking and quality sorting without an auxiliary quality head. A set-softmax/top-1 formulation in the existing referent head is an alternative objective parameterisation of that prior mechanism, not a distinct causal mechanism.
verdict.disposition: Reject before motivation_review, exp_design, implementation, admission or enqueue. Leave the one open design slot empty and do not reopen this idea under a renamed top-1, listwise, softmax-ranking, or hard-negative ID.

limitations: This is a bounded primary-source audit, not an exhaustive literature proof.
The audit rejects the claim of a new core mechanism; it does not assert that the candidate would fail empirically.
No native backward, resource, admission or training evidence was generated because the candidate failed the literature gate.
